statementsIntro:
Five examples also carry the provider's statement for one claim: each Medicare Advantage EOB's `baseline-clean`, the
commercial EOB's `baseline-clean` under each insurer and its `care-settings-clean` under insurer `a`, in variant
`over-owed` where it applies to the billed claim, else `clean`. Each is written as `<name>.bill.pdf` beside the EOB
(render one with `--also bill --bill over-owed`), compared in CI by its page words and ground truth; the Statement
column gives a commercial statement's printed title.
